title: Traversing a Bill of Materials with a LangGraph Agent
summary: Riccardo Pirruccio builds a LangGraph agent team that answers questions about a bill of materials.

chapters.title: Custom Tools and the State Problem
What He Would Change in the Routing

learn: A manufacturing bill of materials is already a graph: a product, its sub-assemblies, and their children down to individual parts.
The agent collaborator pattern uses a router node to send requests between agent nodes and a node holding the tools.
His team has three agents: a graph traverser, a data frame constructor and a chart generator, with the BOM held in a NetworkX graph.
The demo app asks the traverser to find the highest priced parts; it runs Python against the graph and answers.
He hard-coded the graph into a tool because passing state to it was a blocker, and the prompt had to say exactly which graph variable and node attributes to use.
